note: Settings of the document rules. Venue-dependent rules (J1, J3, E6, B4, T5) and the opt-in style rules W20 (abstract structure) and T10 (set T10.method to your method name) are switched off in the register; enable them with "enable" and set the numbers here or in rules.local.json.

figures.note: G1–G4. Widths in TeX pt of your template (IEEEtran and elsarticle 5p: about 252/516; set yours). body_font: auto (from the preamble), times, cm, helvetica, libertine or a regex of font names. Sizes are printed sizes in pt.
